I was looking at your Map, this time around, for what I found in Liurnia that nearly got me to Quit the Game entirely, just in case you already found it, and I just missed it. There is no Grace marked on that particular part of the Map, so it seems you have yet to find it. I will at least tell you that you did, indeed, ruin a Questline by killing Varre. Thankfully, it's one of two Questlines that takes you to my #1 Cause Of Death in Elden Ring's Base Game. #4, counting DLC. I don't want to say too much, but I feel like you'd have a much easier time with it than I did. You'd have already gone through most of the Game before finding that, whereas I encountered it pretty early. Unless you were either waiting until you were ready to face it, or just Advised against setting foot there entirely. Again, it's a little off to the side, so it wouldn't surprise me if you missed it. The last thing I'll tell you is that, Judging by your Map, you actually ran right by it on your way to Altus.
